node.title: The official petal staircase inflation allowance is exactly 719
node.statement: For n in {2^41,2^42,2^43,2^44}, floor(n^6/C(n+6,6))=719. Equivalently, 719C(n+6,6)<=n^6<720C(n+6,6). Thus the complete joint chart-and-codeword inflation available to the petal staircase branch is the constant 719, not an unspecified n^b factor. [IMPORT REPAIR #83 (2026-07-12): '719 is the complete allowance' is gated on the banked n^6 allocation — B_max > 6 would be gated by the named open codegree-conversion emission cell (slack-scan addendum); the cross-ref is binding.]
